newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slightly lower.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 0.22 points lower at 82.10 on Friday from 82.32 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index provisionally fell 8.58 points to 3,551.07.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 18.81 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
